HOW THESE VALUES WERE OBTAINED / ข้อควรระวัง

1) The official xlsx could not be opened directly in this session. Values were taken from greencalculus.com (secondary site that cites DEFRA 2026 cell references) and cross-checked against carbonrecycling.co.uk (national rail).
2) Verify every figure against the official workbook (sheets "Business travel- air", "Business travel- land", "Business travel- sea") before using in a verified report.
3) DEFRA factors reflect UK conditions. For Thai CFO reports, use TGO (อบก.) factors first; use DEFRA only where TGO has no matching factor, and state the reason.
4) Air factors: "With RF" includes radiative forcing (CO2 uplift ~70%). WTT (well-to-tank) is added to either basis. Report which basis is used.
5) 2026 rail/coach factors changed vs 2025 (e.g. national rail 0.03546 -> 0.03092
